_README: Copy to something ending .offer.json -- those are gitignored, because an
offer file is a named employer's confidential numbers.
cp offer.example.json acme.offer.json
python -B offer.py acme.offer.json
python -B offer.py acme.offer.json other.offer.json
Leave a field out rather than guessing at it. A missing field is reported as
UNPRICED, which is the honest state and the one that prompts you to ask; a
guessed field silently becomes part of a total you then rely on.
base                  annual salary
bonus_target_pct      percent of base AT TARGET. Omit if there is no
stated target; set bonus_exists true instead.
pension_type          'DC', 'RRSP match', 'DB', or omit
employer_pension_pct  employer contribution as a percent of base. For DB,
this is the employer's normal cost from the plan's
annual report -- not your contribution rate.
vacation_days         days offered
statutory_vacation_days  your jurisdiction's minimum; defaults to 10
health_premium        employer's annual share, in dollars
pd_budget             annual professional development entitlement
signing_bonus         one-time; reported separately from annual value
other                 {label: annual dollars} for anything else priceable
equity                describe it; never priced
unpriced              list of things you know matter and cannot price yet
unpriced: four days a week on site, and the commute that implies
the role reports two levels lower than the posting suggested
